$comment: Expected outcomes for schema/fixtures3d against schema/scene3d.schema.json alone (raw JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation, e.g. jsonschema.Draft202012Validator in Python or ajv in TypeScript). This file predates the #211 Python/TypeScript validators and only covers what JSON Schema structure can express. See schema/README3d.md's 'Fixtures and the schema/validator split' section for why three malicious/ fixtures are schema-valid here on purpose.
$maliciousComment: These three are deliberately schema-valid: JSON Schema alone cannot express cross-array id uniqueness, dangling groupId references, or a total-payload/object-count limit. #211's validators (mirroring scenes/validation.py's duplicateId/danglingReference/limitExceeded rules for the 2D schema) are expected to reject all three at the validator layer even though the raw schema accepts them.

malicious/duplicate_ids.json.note: schema-valid; rejected by #211's validator as duplicateId

malicious/dangling_group_reference.json.note: schema-valid; rejected by #211's validator as danglingReference

malicious/oversized_document.json.note: schema-valid; rejected by #211's validator as limitExceeded (6000 objects)
